title: Apply the approved initial private EKS baseline
expected_outcome: Repair the discovered node-security-group ownership conflict and baseline apply-role/KMS policy blockers, import only the existing node self-ingress rule and the confirmed CloudTrail resource whose creation preceded state persistence failure, establish the managed VPC CNI and EKS Pod Identity agent prerequisites, then apply a reconfirmed recovery plan and verify essential private-network invariants in account 106760547719.
constraints: Inputs must remain enable_release_signer=false and enable_release_signer_ecr_mirror=false.

The recovery must only reconcile the approved initial baseline; its fresh saved plan must contain no update or destroy except the explicit KMS policy repair required for the previously created keys, replacement of the failed node-operator-managed node group after confirming it has no workloads, or replacement of the EBS CSI add-on that this recovery created but that remained in CREATING before its Pod Identity association existed. The explicitly approved final replacements may terminate the two Ready but workload-free nodes and the stranded add-on only, pass boundary and scope gates, and match the approved account.

Import only the existing node self-ingress security-group rule and the confirmed node-operator-baseline-audit CloudTrail trail, which was created before Terraform state persistence failed. Untaint only the five validated baseline KMS keys created before the rotation-status authorization failure, the verified CloudTrail trail after its non-destructive ListTags state error, and the verified Active vpc-cni addon after its interrupted creation wait, all in the approved Terraform state.

Apply-role permissions must be limited to the initial baseline resource types, regions, and name prefixes; KMS policy access for the execution role must be limited to key-policy lifecycle management needed by Terraform.
Do not create ECR/release resources, mirror images, access Vault/EKS workloads, alter secrets, or record raw state/plan data.

external_actions: read and amend the NodeOperatorTerraformApply IAM policy only for baseline Terraform actions
read AWS provider and backend state through the approved Terraform role
read the node security-group and KMS key identities

import the validated self-ingress rule, the confirmed node-operator-baseline-audit CloudTrail trail after its state-persistence failure, and untaint the five validated baseline KMS keys, the verified CloudTrail trail after its ListTags state error, and the verified Active vpc-cni addon after its interrupted creation wait in the approved Terraform state
create a temporary saved Terraform recovery plan

replace the failed node-operator-managed node group after confirming it has no workloads, including the explicitly approved termination of its two Ready but workload-free nodes, replace only the stranded EBS CSI add-on created by this task after Pod Identity association creation, and apply the exact reconfirmed initial private baseline recovery plan
read back Terraform state and non-sensitive AWS resource metadata for verification

primary_owner.responsibility: apply boundary, security, cost, and final integration

delegations.escalation_trigger: fresh plan differs from approved 99-create scope or shows a destructive action
verification requires secret, workload, or unapproved account access
